open_questions: Red, Yellow, Blue and Brown 'Corridor' routes are not open yet - treat their stop lists as planned alignments, not service.
Orange Line Corridor has only 4 stops here, so it is incomplete.
The repo states no upstream source for its coordinates; a few (Bahria Town, Nursery, Airport) sit several km from the OSM stop of the same name.
